fields.description: Record header magic u32. First word of the 8-byte EEPROM header; verified against all live records in baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_0804ee78 compares first u32 of each 8-byte word to a ROM constant; FUN_0804eac0 requires auStack_34[0]==ROM magic; FUN_0804e960 writes the magic as header word0. Logical offset 0 (rev8 domain).
fields.name: slot0_header_magic

fields.description: Header complement u16. Equals ~magic_lo (0xBBAA); outer validity check is magic_lo + data-byte-sum + this == 0xFFFF.
fields.evidence: FUN_0804e960 constructs header word1 low16 as ~(magic&0xffff); FUN_0804ed88/FUN_0804eac0 verify (header_lo + sum + this)<<16 == ROM const (0xFFFF0000 for zero data). Logical offset 4.
fields.name: slot0_header_check

fields.description: Header reserved u16, always zero in live captures.
fields.evidence: FUN_0804e960 writes header word1 = 0x0000BBAA, so high half is zero; baseline logical bytes are 00 00. Logical offset 6.
fields.name: slot0_header_reserved

fields.description: Inner CRC32 (FUN_0804cbb8: init 0xFFFFFFFF, table-driven, final invert) over record bytes +12..+120; stored here. Not in Schema v2 algorithm list, so kept as a plain field.
fields.evidence: FUN_080188c4 line 316 checks func_0x0804cbb8(buf+4, 108) == u32 at buf+0; FUN_0804cbb8 is a standard CRC32. Logical offset 8. Baseline stores 0 vs actual 0x0f7cfdf3, i.e. empty slot.
fields.name: slot0_data_crc32

fields.description: 3-character slot name/initials; copied to RAM slot bytes 0..2 with NUL terminator.
fields.evidence: FUN_080188c4 lines 367-372 copy 3 bytes from load buffer (record data +4..+6) to RAM slot struct +0..+2 and zero +3. Logical offset 12.
fields.name: slot0_name

fields.description: Primary 32-bit score/counter for slot 0.
fields.evidence: FUN_080188c4 line 379 copies u32 from load buffer (record data +8) to per-slot RAM word. Logical offset 16.
fields.name: slot0_score
